'''Lanya Sunt''' was an individual who served as a [[Constable/Legends|constable]] on the planet [[Sermeria]]. During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Sunt and the [[Sermerian Constabulary]] addressed a bomb threat against President [[Dibra Born]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ister Paddie/Legends|Ister Paddie]].
